mapper.select:
SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT R.*, P.TMPLNAME, P.TOTALSCORE, CONCAT(R.SINGLECHOICEQTY, '/', R.TMPLSINGLECHOICEQTY) SINGLECHOICEQTYRATE, CONCAT(R.MULTIPLECHOICEQTY, '/', R.TMPLMULTIPLECHOICEQTY) MULTIPLECHOICEQTYRATE, CONCAT(R.COMPLETIONQTY, '/', R.TMPLCOMPLETIONQTY) COMPLETIONQTYRATE, CONCAT(R.JUDGEMENTQTY, '/', R.TMPLJUDGEMENTQTY) JUDGEMENTQTYRATE, CONCAT(R.SHORTANSWERQTY, '/', R.TMPLSHORTANSWERQTY) SHORTANSWERQTYRATE FROM T_CORE_EXAM R LEFT JOIN T_CORE_EXAM_TMPL P ON R.EXAMTMPLID = P.ID) T
AND
ORDER BY
T.ID
